options.B: It is formed by the erosion of a coastline.
options.C: It is formed by the movement of tectonic plates.
options.D: It is formed by the action of waves and currents.

questions.stem: The diagram below shows a graph of the relationship between population growth and economic development. Which of the following is a characteristic of this relationship?

options.A: It is a direct relationship, where an increase in population growth leads to an increase in economic development.
options.B: It is an inverse relationship, where an increase in population growth leads to a decrease in economic development.
options.C: It is a non-linear relationship, where an increase in population growth leads to a non-linear increase in economic development.
options.D: It is a complex relationship, where an increase in population growth can lead to both positive and negative effects on economic development.

questions.stem: The diagram below shows a cross-section of a mountain range. Which of the following is a characteristic of this type of mountain range?

options.A: It is formed by the movement of tectonic plates.
options.B: It is formed by the erosion of a coastline.
options.C: It is formed by the action of glaciers.
options.D: It is formed by the deposition of sediment at the mouth of a river.

questions.stem: The diagram below shows a graph of the relationship between temperature and precipitation. Which of the following is a characteristic of this relationship?

options.A: It is a direct relationship, where an increase in temperature leads to an increase in precipitation.
options.B: It is an inverse relationship, where an increase in temperature leads to a decrease in precipitation.
options.C: It is a non-linear relationship, where an increase in temperature leads to a non-linear increase in precipitation.
options.D: It is a complex relationship, where an increase in temperature can lead to both positive and negative effects on precipitation.
